findings.summary: setClientPrenom sync useEffect is dead code — placed on the same line as a // comment
findings.detail: The useEffect that pushes the local prenom state into cartStore.clientPrenom has been accidentally appended to a // comment line. JavaScript treats everything after // to end-of-line as a comment, so the effect never runs. cartStore.clientPrenom stays '' for takeaway orders, causing CartDrawer to initialise prenom as '' and submit orders with no client first name.
findings.fix: Move `useEffect(() => { setClientPrenom(prenom); }, [prenom, setClientPrenom]);` to its own line, below the comment.
